bio: Tree: Salvatore 1915. Round 1 found no public record. Round 2: b. 21 Sep 1915, d. 19 Oct 1990; enlisted in the Army at Wilkes-Barre on 5 Jan 1942; a soldier when he married Elizabeth Notarianni on 16 Oct 1943 (license No. 1716, mother's maiden name 'Farino'); buried in Cathedral Cemetery. Grandson 'Salvador' in the 1920 Ferlaino household.
